title: Vaporwave wallpaper (Mike Grauer Jr)
lede: A free 3D-rendered desktop wallpaper: a striped orange sun over a magenta plain crossed by a warped ribbon grid, under a starry violet sky.
summary: Striped sun, magenta plain, warped teal-green grid, violet starry sky. Free wallpaper, 2018.

evidence.note: Inspected a 1920 × 1080 rendering of the 7680 × 4320 original through [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vaporwave_WP3_Print.jpg) and stored a reduced copy.

styles.note: Partial fit: the author calls it a vaporwave wallpaper and it has the grid floor and striped sun, but it has no collage, statue, or software chrome, and the grid-and-sun scene alone is shared with synthwave. The violet sky, not black, keeps it on the vaporwave side.

context: The author’s description reads: “A new Vaporwave wallpaper! It is free and put under Creative Commons.” The CC BY 2.0 license was confirmed by Commons’ Flickr review bot on December 14, 2023. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vaporwave_WP3_Print.jpg).
observed: The upper half is a flat violet sky full of small white stars.
A large orange-to-yellow sphere with thin horizontal gaps across its lower half sits left of centre on the horizon.
The ground is a magenta plain, lighter toward the horizon, covered by a grid of twisted ribbons in green, teal, and pink that rises into jagged peaks at the right.
interpretation: A clean example of the grid-and-sun motif that vaporwave shares with synthwave. The rubric separates them by the sky: violet and pastel here, black in synthwave.
borrow: Cut three or four horizontal gaps through the lower half of a sun disc to get the striped-sun motif without a separate stripe layer.

images.alt: 3D-rendered landscape: a striped orange sun on the horizon, a magenta plain crossed by a warped green and teal ribbon grid rising into peaks, and a violet sky with stars.
images.caption: Vaporwave wallpaper by Mike Grauer Jr, 2018. CC BY 2.0. [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vaporwave_WP3_Print.jpg), from [Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/mike_grauer/26310058937/).
